High-level asks:
- Short demo focused on Private/VPC deployment, network requirements, and compliance controls (SOC2, data residency).
- Attendees: me (Alyssa, IT lead), plus our security lead (secops@medsecure.com) and procurement.
- Timing: Prefer Jul 27\u201329 in the morning PT, but flexible if needed.

Can you connect me with the right SE and schedule a short 45-min walkthrough? Also would appreciate any pre-read docs you can share (SOC2 artifacts, deployment checklist).

Thanks,
